clippings.speaker: Steven Spielberg
clippings.quote: The first movie was fraught with, 'I don't want to say anything that Tom's not going to like. I want to keep his friendship. I like this guy and his family. God, don't let me do anything that's going to screw that up.'
clippings.title: Hanks, Spielberg maintain 'Terminal' friendship
clippings.context: Joint AP interview for The Terminal, recalling his anxiety on their first film together.

clippings.speaker: Tom Hanks
clippings.quote: I sort of said, 'Look, you know ... you can't offend me. You're the boss. Tell me what you like, and if you don't like my ideas say: That's nice, but we're going to do something different.'
clippings.title: Hanks, Spielberg maintain 'Terminal' friendship
clippings.context: Same joint interview, responding to Spielberg's account; Hanks said the tiptoeing lasted a week.

clippings.speaker: Tom Hanks
clippings.quote: He can say anything to me and I think vice versa and whatever answer comes out is perfect. To be relaxed on a movie set means you can get stuff out that you haven't even imagined before, and that comes from knowing each other.
clippings.title: Hanks, Spielberg maintain 'Terminal' friendship
clippings.context: Joint AP interview for The Terminal.

clippings.speaker: Steven Spielberg
clippings.quote: I actively look for things for him. Literally, I actively try to find projects we can work together on.
clippings.title: Hanks, Spielberg maintain 'Terminal' friendship
clippings.context: Joint AP interview; he went on to note he had found Road to Perdition for Hanks.

clippings.speaker: Steven Spielberg
clippings.quote: It was going to be a tremendous performance opportunity for Tom, and I wanted to be in on that, around that...I wanted to be in his zone.
clippings.title: Hanks, Spielberg maintain 'Terminal' friendship
clippings.context: On asking to direct The Terminal after learning Hanks was considering the lead.

clippings.speaker: Steven Spielberg
clippings.quote: I guess my mantra is very simple. I say, 'That was great, that was brilliant! Once more. Once more.'
clippings.title: Steven Spielberg and Tom Hanks collaborate once again in "Bridge of Spies"
clippings.context: Asked by Gayle King how one tells Tom Hanks to do a take over.

clippings.speaker: Tom Hanks
clippings.quote: The best thing that can happen on the set is where Steven disappears, you don't know where he is, and then you see him out of the corner of your eye somewhere on the periphery of the set with a finder up to his eye… It means he's looking for something that's gonna be solid gold. And you just hope you're in it somewhere.
clippings.title: Steven Spielberg and Tom Hanks collaborate once again in "Bridge of Spies"
clippings.context: His advice to fellow Bridge of Spies actors who asked what to expect from Spielberg (two answers joined across Gayle King's question).

notes: Two rich joint interviews (AP 2004 via TODAY; CBS This Morning 2015). Time's 2015 joint interview blocked to direct fetch; Hollywood Reporter redirected to a paywall gateway, skipped.
